name: Create Telegram bot
description: Creates a Telegram bot that acts as you and starts it immediately. Get a token from @BotFather, store it as a secret (v/ops/secret/set, e.g. TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN) and pass it as token "s/TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN" — literal tokens are refused. Choose exactly one inbound handler: agent (one agent:chat conversation per Telegram chat with an agent you own) or operation (every Telegram Update is handed to that operation, with reply true|false|"fixed text"). Access is fail-closed: list Telegram user ids / @usernames in allow, or set open: true. The bot is recorded in the venue-private adapter workspace under users/<your-did>/bots/<name> and comes back after a venue restart; delete it with v/ops/telegram/delete. Requires telegram/manage on <you>/telegram/<name>. Bots that act as another identity are declared by the operator in venue config, not here.

name.description: Bot name, unique among your bots ([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)

token.description: Secret reference to the BotFather token, e.g. s/TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN

agent.description: Agent id to converse with (one session per Telegram chat). Exclusive with operation.

operation.description: Operation reference invoked with each Telegram Update. Exclusive with agent.

reply.description: For operation handlers: true (send the result, default), false (silent), or a fixed acknowledgement

allow.description: Telegram user ids and/or @usernames allowed to talk to the bot

parseMode.description: Reply formatting; omit for plain text

output.description: The bot's status record (as in telegram:bots): name, user, target, state, managed: runtime, ...
